_toRestore: TWO DIFFERENT EVENTS, TWO DIFFERENT ACTIONS -- this field collided in the Nov 5 rebase because each half was written for one of them. A DATE THAT PASSES: LEAVE THE ENTRY IN `upcoming`. Every surface filters `date >= today`, so a past session is already invisible to all of them, and /workshop reads the LATEST PAST entry to name the workshop that happened. Emptying the array throws that away and the page can then only say there is no next date. A DATE THAT IS CANCELLED OR POSTPONED: EMPTY `upcoming`. Nothing happened, so there is nothing for the page to name. This is what was done on Nov 2 2026 when Nov 7 was postponed, and it is why the array is empty now. THE CONSEQUENCE, AND IT IS THE WHOLE POINT: the happened-branch can only ever name a session that actually ran, because a session that did not run is not in the array to be found. Do NOT put a cancelled date back in to "switch the feature on" -- /workshop and /workshop/sponsored would tell people a workshop happened that was called off, and the speaker heading would flip to "Who was in the room" for a room nobody sat in.
